title: A Graph-Based Analysis of Comparability, Scale, and Attribution in Private Transformer Inference
abstract: arXiv:2610.19607v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Rising privacy concerns around large language models have accelerated research in private Transformer inference (PTI). Synthesizing the empirical claims in this line of research, however, is hindered by multi-dimensional cryptographic progress and inconsistent evaluation contracts. In this work, we systematize the field by constructing an empirical graph of 62 PTI systems, mapping system attributes to node features and evaluation compatibility to edges. A three-tiered analysis of this graph illuminates the state of private inference. Node-level attribution shows that cryptographic progress drives performance gains across most systems, yet always co-occurs with other factors (model fidelity, hardware, cost accounting). Edge-level auditing shows that only 1 of 1891 candidate system pairs is directly comparable under shared assumptions. Finally, graph-level analysis shows that the scaling frontier of private inference has plateaued at 13B

translated_title: 基于图的分析：私有Transformer推理中的可比性、规模与归因
translated_abstract: 围绕大语言模型日益增长的隐私担忧加速了私有Transformer推理（PTI）的研究。然而，综合该研究方向的实证结论却受到多维度密码学进展和不一致评估契约的阻碍。在这项工作中，我们通过构建一个包含62个PTI系统的实证图来对该领域进行系统化梳理，将系统属性映射为节点特征，将评估兼容性映射为边。对该图的三层分析阐明了私有推理的现状。节点级归因表明，密码学进步推动了大多数系统的性能提升，但总是与其他因素（模型保真度、硬件、成本核算）共同出现。边级审计表明，在1891个候选系统对中，只有1对在共享假设下可直接比较。最后，图级分析表明，私有推理的扩展前沿已在13B规模处趋于停滞。
tldr: 该论文通过构建包含62个私有Transformer推理（PTI）系统的实证图并进行节点、边、图三层分析，揭示了密码学进步总是与其他因素共同驱动性能提升、1891个候选系统对中仅1对可直接比较、以及私有推理的扩展前沿已在13B规模停滞等重要发现。
en_tdlr: This paper constructs an empirical graph of 62 private Transformer inference (PTI) systems and conducts node-, edge-, and graph-level analysis, revealing that cryptographic progress always co-occurs with other factors in driving performance gains, only 1 of 1891 candidate system pairs is directly comparable, and the scaling frontier of private inference has plateaued at 13B.
